config.ts: nuxfire config file - domain, auth email, feature flags
apps/: deployable applications and services (one browsable UI or worker set each)
apps/app/: the main app (dashboard) - deployed to app.domain.com
apps/functions/: cloudflare workers for: auth, websockets, emails, jobs, cron
apps/web/: landing page, docs and blog - deployed to domain.com
patches/: the hacks to get things working on workers runtime
patches/nodemailer@6.10.1.patch: get nodemailer to work on workers
scripts/: extra scripts for the boring stuff
scripts/dev.ts: script to start dev server and execute commands
sst-env.d.ts: types that get autogenerated by sst.dev
sst.config.ts: the deployment magic with sst.dev starts here
